title: Implement Trie (Prefix Tree)
description:
A **trie** (prefix tree) stores strings so that prefix lookups are fast. Implement the `Trie` class:

- `Trie()` creates an empty trie.
- `insert(word)` adds the string `word`.
- `search(word)` returns `true` if `word` was inserted earlier, otherwise `false`.
- `startsWith(prefix)` returns `true` if some inserted word begins with `prefix`.

Tests describe a sequence of calls as two arrays: the operation names (starting with the class name) and their arguments. The expected output has `null` for the constructor and for methods that return nothing.
constraints: word and prefix consist of lowercase English letters.
hints: Each trie node holds a map from a letter to a child node and a flag that says "a word ends here".
search and startsWith both walk the letters of the query; they differ only in whether the final node must be marked as a word end.
